summary: Completed testing of Guest CRM 360 (Revinate-killer) and Channel Manager v2 (OTA adapter framework) - Iteration 275. All 22 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified with all required data-testid attributes present and functional. Turkish UI working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test bookings created for CRM profile testing. Channel sync jobs created during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM 360 and Channel Manager v2 features fully tested. Both features accessible via sidebar navigation (Guests > Guest CRM 360, Revenue > Channels & Parity > Channel Manager v2). All data-testid attributes verified.

crm_360_backend: GET /api/crm/profile/{guest_email} - returns 360° view with stats (total_stays, lifetime_value, days_since_last_stay, properties_visited), lifecycle stage, and computed segments
GET /api/crm/segments - aggregates up to 500 guests, returns counts per segment (champion: 1, repeat: 95, first-time: 404, lapsed: 229)
GET /api/crm/winback/candidates?days_inactive=N - returns guests sorted by lifetime_value desc
POST /api/crm/winback/queue - queues emails into guest_campaigns collection (status='queued')
Role-based access: receptionist can read profile, manager/admin required for segments and winback
crm_360_frontend: Panel accessible via Guests > Guest CRM 360 in sidebar
8 segment cards with data-testid='crm-seg-{name}' (vip, champion, advocate, repeat, first-time, lapsed, dormant, at-risk)
Winback section with data-testid='winback-days' dropdown and data-testid='winback-queue-btn' button
Member list shows 50 guests per segment with name, email, lifetime_value, last_stay
Turkish UI labels (Misafir Profilleri & Segmentler, Win-Back Kampanya, etc.)
channels_v2_backend: GET /api/channels/v2/adapters - lists 6 OTAs (Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb, Agoda, Hotels.com, Google) with health_7d stats
POST /api/channels/v2/configure - validates adapter enum, stores credentials per adapter
POST /api/channels/v2/queue/push - enqueues job with validated adapter + job_type, fires async dispatch
POST /api/channels/v2/queue/{id}/retry - sets status back to pending and retries
GET /api/channels/v2/history - shows audit trail with ok/error/ota_ref
GET /api/channels/v2/health - returns by_adapter success/fail counts and queue (pending, failed)
Job status transitions: pending → in-flight → completed (or failed/pending with backoff)
channels_v2_frontend: Panel accessible via Revenue > Channels & Parity > Channel Manager v2 in sidebar
6 adapter cards with data-testid='adapter-{key}' showing name, protocol, rate_limit, health stats
3 tabs: OTA Adapterları, Kuyruk, Geçmiş with data-testid='channels-tab-{name}'
Test Sync buttons with data-testid='adapter-test-{key}' - clicking shows toast 'Test sync kuyruğa eklendi'
Queue tab shows jobs with status badges (completed/failed/pending/in-flight), retry buttons
History tab shows audit trail with timestamps, OTA refs, error details
Health summary showing Kuyrukta: N, Başarısız: N

mocked_apis.channel_manager_v2: OTA calls are SIMULATED (80% success / 15% transient / 5% permanent). Real adapter SDKs (Booking.com, Expedia EQC, Airbnb) are hot-swappable when API credentials arrive.

role_access_verified.admin: Full access to all CRM and Channels v2 endpoints
role_access_verified.manager: Full access to all CRM and Channels v2 endpoints (except configure which is admin-only)
role_access_verified.receptionist: Can access CRM profile only, denied access to segments, winback, and channels v2
